errors.text_span: with the critiquing component contributing the most significant improvement in performance
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly concludes that the critiquing component contributes the most significant improvement. The largest drop in performance from the "Ours" model (0.21) is when the scoring component is removed ("- scoring" has a value of ~0.07, a drop of ~0.14), not when the critiquing component is removed ("- critiquing" has a value of ~0.19, a drop of only ~0.02).
